nodes.label: Human-governed alert control station
nodes.rationale: The operator remains in the loop for alert acknowledgement, investigation review, human disposition, recovery approval, and operational execution.

nodes.label: Self-contained lexical RAG index
nodes.rationale: The local retriever keeps the demo portable and auditable while preserving the human approval and endpoint execution gates.

nodes.label: Recovery approval gate
nodes.rationale: Confirmed incidents require a separate approval before any operational endpoint can run, keeping recovery execution behind an explicit human gate.

nodes.label: SOP-05 Vessel arrival and tug-window conflict
nodes.norm_label: sop-05 vessel arrival and tug-window conflict

nodes.label: Minimum immediate containment actions
nodes.rationale: The playbook limits immediate response to the minimum safe tool plan and excludes follow-up work unless the alert explicitly requires it.

nodes.label: Agent activity board
nodes.rationale: The annunciator panel is driven by recorded actions, so activity lights reflect real workflow stages rather than an animation script.

nodes.label: Approved combined endpoint set
nodes.rationale: Only the approved combined endpoint set is dispatched, so proposed tools cannot execute until the complete plan is approved and validated.
